Find files under blocks/ containing the same line three times consecutively.

candidates.command: find blocks/ -type f -exec awk 'FNR > 2 && prev1 == prev2 && prev2 == $0 { print FILENAME; exit } { prev1 = prev2; prev2 = $0 }' {} ';'
find blocks/ -type f -exec awk 'FNR==1 {a=$0; n=1; p=0; next} {if ($0==a) {n++; if (n==3 && !p) {print FILENAME; p=1}} else {a=$0; n=1}}' {} +
find blocks/ -type f -exec awk 'FNR==1 {prev1=""; prev2=""; printed=0} $0==prev1 && $0==prev2 {if (!printed) {print FILENAME; printed=1}} {prev2=prev1; prev1=$0}' {} +
find blocks/ -type f -exec awk 'FNR==1 {prev=$0; c=1; next} {if ($0==prev) c++; else {prev=$0; c=1}; if (c==3) {print FILENAME; exit}}' {} \;
find blocks/ -type f -exec awk 'FNR==1{cnt=0;flag=0;prev=""} {if(FNR==1)cnt=1; else if($0==prev)cnt++; else cnt=1; prev=$0; if(cnt==3&&!flag){print FILENAME; flag=1}}' {} +
